page.overview:
Who is Dalash Ard?

Dalash Ard was a female Mandalorian warrior who lived during the war against Zakuul. During the Mandalorian raid on Zakuul droid factory, Dalash was one of the team leaders who assisted The Commander during the attack, helping destroy many Skytroopers.

Dalash Ard first appeared in the 14th chapter of Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire Mandalore's Revenge.
